english.name: Sweden Motorcycle Theory Test (A, A1, A2)
english.fullName: Swedish motorcycle licence knowledge test (kunskapsprov) for categories A1, A2 and A, in Swedish

notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count), no spares. Real test (Trafikverket, checked 2026-11-06): 70 questions with one right answer, 5 trial questions not scored, max 65 points, 52 to pass (80%), 50 minutes, read aloud in Swedish; Trafikverket names five knowledge areas (fordonskännedom och manövrering, miljö, trafiksäkerhet, trafikregler, personliga förutsättningar) but publishes no weights, so the 9-category split is Tigertest's own. Tigertest's mock tests are 50 questions at 80% (40 of 50), same pace. Training: five topic sets 23201-23205 (Fordon+Manöver 52, Placering+Regler 52, Passagerare+Behörighet 32, Väglag 28, Personlig+Miljö 36) = 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 steps.
